cells.name: E. coli
cells.note: Facultative heterotroph. Ferments to acetate, formate and ethanol when O2 runs short.

reactions.name: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: eco@g3p_c + eco@nad_c + eco@pi_c <=> eco@13dpg_c + eco@h_c + eco@nadh_c

reactions.name: PEP synthase (gluconeogenesis from pyruvate)
reactions.equation: eco@atp_c + eco@h2o_c + eco@pyr_c --> eco@amp_c + 2 eco@h_c + eco@pep_c + eco@pi_c

reactions.name: Citrate synthase
reactions.equation: eco@accoa_c + eco@h2o_c + eco@oaa_c --> eco@cit_c + eco@coa_c + eco@h_c

reactions.name: 2-Oxoglutarate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: eco@akg_c + eco@coa_c + eco@nad_c --> eco@co2_c + eco@nadh_c + eco@succoa_c

reactions.name: Succinyl-CoA synthetase
reactions.equation: eco@atp_c + eco@coa_c + eco@succ_c <=> eco@adp_c + eco@pi_c + eco@succoa_c

reactions.name: Malate synthase
reactions.equation: eco@accoa_c + eco@glx_c + eco@h2o_c --> eco@coa_c + eco@h_c + eco@mal__L_c

reactions.name: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase
reactions.equation: eco@co2_c + eco@h2o_c + eco@pep_c --> eco@h_c + eco@oaa_c + eco@pi_c

reactions.name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: eco@coa_c + eco@nad_c + eco@pyr_c --> eco@accoa_c + eco@co2_c + eco@nadh_c

reactions.name: Acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (acetylating)
reactions.equation: eco@acald_c + eco@coa_c + eco@nad_c <=> eco@accoa_c + eco@h_c + eco@nadh_c

reactions.name: NADH dehydrogenase (pumps H+ into the periplasm)
reactions.equation: 4 eco@h_c + eco@nadh_c + eco@q8_c --> 3 eco@h_p + eco@nad_c + eco@q8h2_c

reactions.name: Cytochrome bd oxidase
reactions.equation: 2 eco@h_c + 0.5 eco@o2_c + eco@q8h2_c --> eco@h2o_c + 2 eco@h_p + eco@q8_c

reactions.name: ATP synthase (proton-motive force)
reactions.equation: eco@adp_c + 4 eco@h_p + eco@pi_c <=> eco@atp_c + eco@h2o_c + 3 eco@h_c

reactions.name: Membrane transhydrogenase
reactions.equation: 2 eco@h_p + eco@nadh_c + eco@nadp_c --> 2 eco@h_c + eco@nad_c + eco@nadph_c

reactions.name: Biomass (E. coli core, with GAM)
reactions.equation: 1.496 eco@3pg_c + 3.7478 eco@accoa_c + 59.81 eco@atp_c + 0.361 eco@e4p_c + 0.0709 eco@f6p_c + 0.129 eco@g3p_c + 0.205 eco@g6p_c + 0.2557 eco@gln__L_c + 4.9414 eco@glu__L_c + 59.81 eco@h2o_c + 3.547 eco@nad_c + 13.0279 eco@nadph_c + 1.7867 eco@oaa_c + 0.5191 eco@pep_c + 2.8328 eco@pyr_c + 0.8977 eco@r5p_c --> 59.81 eco@adp_c + 4.1182 eco@akg_c + 3.7478 eco@coa_c + 59.81 eco@h_c + 3.547 eco@nadh_c + 13.0279 eco@nadp_c + 59.81 eco@pi_c

reactions.name: Glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP)
reactions.equation: eco@glu__L_c + eco@h2o_c + eco@nadp_c <=> eco@akg_c + eco@h_c + eco@nadph_c + eco@nh4_c

reactions.name: Glutamine synthetase
reactions.equation: eco@atp_c + eco@glu__L_c + eco@nh4_c --> eco@adp_c + eco@gln__L_c + eco@h_c + eco@pi_c

texts.text: NADPH and pentoses; the carbon returns as F6P and G3P
NADH to O2 pumps H+ out; ATP synthase lets it back
